annotations.text:
Three views of ONE page — the site home.

Tokens, radii and control heights are lifted from the app prototype (seed #6750A4, Material baseline). Type is scaled up for reading distance; the app itself sits at 13px body.

Honesty holds the layout in three places:
• The download control is off and says why — no release exists yet.
• Screenshot slots say capture pending rather than showing a mockup.
• The unsigned-installer warning is stated up front, not in a footnote.

Swap the theme chip above each artboard for light.

Frames match measured render heights at 1280px and 390px, with no horizontal overflow at either width.

On the phone artboard the tab strip becomes a scrolling pill row rather than a side strip, so it stops eating the width it exists to reveal. Touch targets are 44px.

Not drawn yet — say the word and they get artboards:

• Features index (every feature, not a highlight reel)
• Documentation article template with suggested-articles footer
• The site's own settings surface (language, funny sliders, appearance)
• Changelog viewer with date picker and commit links
